summary: Jadiwangi App full backend + frontend smoke tested. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases passed against public URL (auth for all 3 roles incl. wrong-pin 401, master data CRUD, order full lifecycle create->advance->pay->completed & cancel, dashboard w/ outlet filter, all 4 report endpoints, expenses/adjustments/leaderboard). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Owner login PIN 1234 auto-submits and lands on Owner Home rendering KPIs (7 trx / 26 kg / 18 pcs / 5 pelanggan, Pendapatan Rp647.000, Omzet Rp877.000), Trend chart, Antrian Pekerjaan (13/5/6), Top Layanan list, Buat Order FAB. Order tab pipeline filter chips render. Buat Order modal loads customer/services/segmented delivery/Lanjut Bayar. Laporan Keuangan renders omzet/pendapatan/pengeluaran/kasbon/laba + expense breakdown. Setelan lists all 6 menu-<route> items + logout button. Pegawai PIN 3333 -> employee tabs (Antrian + Antar Jemput) with pipeline filter chips. Pelanggan (last-4 phone) requires explicit submit tap; leaderboard + 'Order Sekarang' render correctly. Wrong owner PIN shows 'PIN Owner salah'. One console deprecation warning noted for shadow* style props.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — appears from a component using RN Web deprecated shadow shorthand. Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow / RN shadow API.

action_items: Optional: replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (web) with boxShadow to silence deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~900-line file — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into modules (auth, orders, reports) once >700 lines threshold is a concern.

Pelanggan login by 'last-4 phone' with LIKE '%digits' can match multiple customers; currently returns first by created_at — acceptable per spec but note it can log the user in as a different customer if digits collide.
No auth token/session — server trusts client role; acceptable given PIN-only MVP scope.
MONGO_URL / DB_NAME still present in backend/.env but unused (Supabase is the DB). Safe to leave since protected but flagged for cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup (3 outlets, 8 services, 25 customers, 6 employees, ~250 orders/30d, expenses). Tests created a few TEST_-prefixed rows (svc, customer, employee, expense, adjustment, orders) that persist in Supabase — recommend a periodic cleanup or teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://wangi-dashboard.preview.emergentagent.com; owner PIN 1234 auto-submits (only owner); pelanggan/pegawai require pressing key-submit. Test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~46s in parallel. Deprecation warning about shadow* style props is only console noise.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking flows; all requested features & endpoints pass smoke.
